name: Illinois Toxics Release Inventory (TRI) - Curated Dataset 2010-2024
description: A curated, reproducible dataset derived from the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Toxics Release Inventory (TRI) Basic Data Files for Illinois, covering reporting years 2010 through 2024. The dataset integrates 15 annual CSV files into a unified research resource with systematic quality assessment, curation flags, multiple structured derivative outputs, documentation, provenance records, and preservation-oriented metadata.

isBasedOn.name: Toxics Release Inventory (TRI) Basic Data Files

measurementTechnique: Annual self-reported regulatory data submitted by industrial facilities under EPCRA Section 313 using EPA Form R or Form A Certification Statement.
variableMeasured: Total on-site and off-site chemical releases

distribution.name: BASE_COMBINED.csv
distribution.description: Combined annual EPA TRI files before curation flags.

distribution.name: CLEANED_RECORDS.csv
distribution.description: Flagged, cleaned record-level dataset. Unit: facility x chemical x year.

distribution.name: INDUSTRY_TIME_SERIES.csv
distribution.description: Annual aggregated totals by NAICS industry sector.

distribution.name: CHEMICAL_SUMMARY.csv
distribution.description: All-years chemical release totals ranked by total release volume.

distribution.name: CHEMICAL_YEAR_TIME_SERIES.csv
distribution.description: Release trends per chemical per year with chemical metadata.

curationActivities: Numeric prefix stripping from column names
Numeric type coercion for quantity fields
Pathway aggregation for air and water releases
knownLimitations: PFAS data are available from Reporting Year 2020 only.
POTW calculation methodology changed around Reporting Year 2014.
Releases are facility-estimated, not directly measured.
Only above-threshold facilities report under TRI; the dataset does not capture all statewide emissions.
Facility openings, closures, mergers, and threshold changes may affect trend interpretation.
Some chemical identities are sanitized as trade-secret submissions.
TRI data alone cannot determine direct exposure or health risk.

missingValueConventions.zeroReleaseValues: A value of 0 in release fields may represent a true zero, not applicable pathway, historical blank reporting, or Form A reporting. Users should interpret zero values using FORM TYPE and curation flags.
missingValueConventions.missingReleaseFlag: FLAG_MISSING_RELEASE identifies records where TOTAL_RELEASES is missing.
missingValueConventions.formAFlag: FLAG_FORM_A identifies Form A certification records.

provenance.source: U.S. EPA TRI Basic Data Files

fairAlignment.findable: Repository metadata, descriptive title, keywords, GitHub repository, Zenodo Sandbox record, and CITATION.cff are provided.
fairAlignment.accessible: Data and documentation are shared in open file formats through GitHub and Zenodo Sandbox.
fairAlignment.interoperable: CSV, JSON, Markdown, EPA identifiers, TRIFID, CAS, FRS ID, and NAICS fields support interoperability.
fairAlignment.reusable: Data dictionary, user guide, curation log, provenance documentation, known limitations, and quality flags support informed reuse.
